page.notes: The syllogism figure has braces, which are drawn and not printed text. The letters A, B, C are labels beside the boxes, and I have put them after the box with a bar. The left column of premises and the right column of boxes share the same lines, so the row order is approximate. The long s is rendered as s throughout, and u/v and i/j are normalised as the rules require. The tilde in "Mediũ" is kept as printed. No catchword, signature or margin notes are visible.
